assumptions.assumption: Absorbed decode treats the latent cache as one KV head with kv_lora_rank value width.
assumptions.notes: If cache/value width differs, the w_vc de-absorption GEMM reads the wrong latent basis.

assumptions.assumption: q_nope is multiplied by w_kc before attention and attention output by w_vc after attention.
assumptions.notes: The algebraic rewrite is correct only if these weights are the model's absorbed K/V projections.

assumptions.assumption: FP8 absorbed weights require explicit scale compensation before/inside the BMM path.
assumptions.notes: Without matching scales FP8 dequantization changes logits/values.

assumptions.assumption: The selected attention backend supports a single-KV-head MQA shape.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: page_size: Size of each page in the paged KV cache. Must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128].
assumptions.notes: FlashInfer documents num_kv_heads and paged KV cache shapes; violations become adapter/kernel shape errors.

assumptions.assumption: No-prefix extend can be routed as dense prefill without reading cached-prefix latent states.
assumptions.notes: If any request has a prefix, normal prefill would omit cached-prefix attention.

assumptions.assumption: Materialized k_nope/v prefill is semantically equivalent to absorbed MLA for full-context attention.
assumptions.notes: The code implements both paths, but no public spec states their numerical tolerance equivalence.

assumptions.assumption: Dense prefill is profitable only when the no-prefix workload is large enough to amortize materialized K/V.
assumptions.code_evidence: staging/moves/L2-moves-final.json: performance_evidence None found beyond PR/diff
assumptions.notes: Catalog evidence names the split but does not provide a stable performance contract.

assumptions.assumption: Backend must support materialized per-head K/V prefill for the chosen dtype.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: page_size: Size of each page in the paged KV cache. Must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128].
assumptions.notes: FlashInfer documents K/V cache dtype/shape constraints for paged attention; analogous library calls rely on those constraints.

assumptions.assumption: Every request's KV span is split by the per-batch num_kv_splits used by stage 1 and merge.
assumptions.notes: Mismatched split counts would merge missing or uninitialized partials.

assumptions.assumption: Stage 1 stores both partial values and LSE for every non-empty split.
assumptions.notes: Online-softmax merge needs LSE to rescale partial outputs.

assumptions.assumption: Triton program instances can communicate only via global-memory partial buffers across kernel phases.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: This function will be compiled and run on the GPU.
assumptions.notes: The two-stage design avoids assuming inter-CTA synchronization inside one kernel.

assumptions.assumption: The LSE merge order is numerically tolerated but not bitwise deterministic across split choices.
assumptions.notes: Specs do not promise split-count-independent floating-point associativity; accuracy relies on tolerance tests.

assumptions.assumption: Plan buffers and wrapper objects are reused across run calls instead of reconstructed per layer.
assumptions.notes: Reconstruction would reintroduce planning overhead.

assumptions.assumption: CUDA-graph metadata uses fixed device buffers and host-derived indptrs during replay.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: CUDA graphs record CUDA work for later replay; graph capture has restrictions on operations and dependencies.
assumptions.notes: If addresses/shapes changed after capture, graph replay would use stale metadata.

assumptions.assumption: fast_mla_decode_plan bypasses upstream blocking scalar reads only after a real plan initialized cached modules.
assumptions.notes: Skipping the initial plan would leave FlashInfer module state unset.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer page_size and paged KV layouts match the wrapper's plan/run contract.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: page_size: Size of each page in the paged KV cache. Must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128].
assumptions.notes: Wrong page size or layout invalidates the library call rather than a kernel-local invariant.

assumptions.assumption: Ragged prefill is selected only for no-prefix extend and outside CUDA graph modes.
assumptions.notes: Prefix-bearing requests need paged-prefix handling, not ragged no-prefix prefill.

assumptions.assumption: Ragged Q metadata is packed by cumulative query sequence lengths.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: page_size: Size of each page in the paged KV cache. Must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128].
assumptions.notes: FlashInfer documents q_cu_seq_lens packing for ragged Q.

assumptions.assumption: CUDA graph paths must force paged/non-ragged wrappers with preallocated graph metadata.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: CUDA graphs record CUDA work for later replay; graph capture has restrictions on operations and dependencies.
assumptions.notes: Ragged dynamic packing would change captured launch metadata.

assumptions.assumption: Profitability depends on no-prefix prefill avoiding paged wrapper overhead.
assumptions.notes: No library spec promises ragged is faster for all no-prefix batches.

assumptions.assumption: get_mla_metadata must produce tile_scheduler_metadata and num_splits from the exact current sequence lengths.
assumptions.notes: Stale metadata schedules the wrong KV tiles.

assumptions.assumption: FlashMLA integration requires page_size == PAGE_SIZE (64 in the FlashMLA wrapper).
assumptions.notes: The extension's page-index helpers are specialized to this page geometry.

assumptions.assumption: CUDA graph replay copies recomputed metadata into fixed graph buffers before run.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: CUDA graphs record CUDA work for later replay; graph capture has restrictions on operations and dependencies.
assumptions.notes: Changing graph input addresses would violate capture/replay assumptions.

assumptions.assumption: num_splits shape is batch-size dependent and must match tile metadata.
assumptions.notes: Mismatched splits cause the extension to merge incorrect split partitions.

assumptions.assumption: MLA cache row stores latent noPE values followed by RoPE dimensions in one buffer.
assumptions.notes: Fused writers assume the noPE/RoPE boundary is exactly kv_lora_rank.

assumptions.assumption: Paged HND layouts require (size+page_size) divisible by page_size.
assumptions.notes: Otherwise page index arithmetic can address past the intended page.

assumptions.assumption: FP8 fused KV writes rely on destination FP8-typed views and explicit scale buffers.
assumptions.code_evidence: python/sglang/kernels/ops/kvcache/mla_buffer.py:330: Destination pointer is FP8-typed view; tl.store performs downcast
assumptions.notes: Absent scales or wrong view dtype corrupt quantized cache values.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer-compatible page sizes must be among its documented page sizes.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: page_size: Size of each page in the paged KV cache. Must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128].
assumptions.notes: Adapters can further restrict page size, but cannot violate upstream accepted page geometry.

assumptions.assumption: FA3 MLA path only runs when attention_arch is MLA and FA implementation version is 3.
assumptions.notes: FA2/older wrappers do not expose the MLA-specific q_rope/k_rope path.

assumptions.assumption: MLA decode maps RoPE-only query and RoPE cache to flash_attn_with_kvcache.
assumptions.notes: Passing concatenated/full Q to the RoPE-only cache path would change logits.

assumptions.assumption: Default selection assumes Hopper/CUDA support for FA3 kernels.
assumptions.spec_excerpt: Technical specifications are listed per compute capability, including resources and supported hardware features.
assumptions.notes: CUDA compute capability specs anchor architecture-specific support; the exact FA3 support is a library condition.
